plans.note: Section 11.5 (p0572) is a mutual all-caps waiver of indirect/consequential/punitive damages; check carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, willful misconduct). No monetary aggregate cap located — confirm absence and note an uncapped mutual regime is generally acceptable to us here.

11.2 (p0560) is Harpoon's indemnity of AbbVie Indemnitees; 11.1 (p0559) is our reciprocal indemnity — check scope (IP infringement, breach of reps, negligence/willful misconduct) and that our indemnity stays narrow. 11.3–11.4 (p0561–p0569) are notice and control-of-defense mechanics; p0471 is indemnity in the IP enforcement context.

Section 5.8 'Exclusivity with Respect to the Territory' (p0367–p0369) restricts Competing Products; determine which Party is bound. Snippets suggest it runs against Harpoon with an Acquisition/Change-in-Control Segregation carve-out — if it binds only the counterparty it benefits us and must not be flagged. See Competitor (p0102) and Segregate (p0228).

Exclusivity sits in 5.8 (p0367–p0369) plus the exclusive grants to AbbVie in 5.1 (p0351–p0356) and Harpoon's retained rights in 5.6.1 (p0363). Confirm no sourcing/requirements exclusivity is imposed on AbbVie; exclusive grants in our favour are not flagged. Do not double-flag the term addressed under NONCOMPETE.

No hits for most favored/favoured, more favorable, no less favorable, best terms across multiple passes. Treat as absent unless a worker finds pricing-parity language inside a redacted [***] payment provision in Article 6.

No non-solicit or no-hire covenant found (solicit/recruit/induce/no-hire returned nothing on point). p0424 is an anti-bribery style restriction on payments to the other Party's employees; p0263 concerns committee attendance. Expect missing/not applicable.

Section 12.3 (p0590) appears to give AbbVie at-will termination in whole or country-by-country — confirm notice period and any exit payment. Check Harpoon's rights (12.2 breach, 12.4 insolvency at p0591) to confirm no convenience right for the counterparty. Consequences at p0596, p0633, p0640.

12.1.1 (p0582) runs the Term from the Effective Date until expiry of royalty obligations or earlier termination; p0300 covers automatic termination if the License Option lapses. No auto-renewal or non-renewal notice window appears — confirm and note the evergreen structure carries no renewal pricing risk.

13.6.1 (p0652) selects Delaware law — an accepted jurisdiction. 13.7 (p0655–p0657) layers escalation plus arbitration; confirm a US seat and that court litigation remains available for carve-out disputes (p0656) and injunctive relief (p0670). Service at p0653.

13.4 Assignment (p0647) is the core clause — confirm our right to assign to Affiliates and successors without consent. 13.2 Change in Control of Harpoon (p0643) with p0273 and p0369 give us rights on a Harpoon CIC (favourable; do not flag). Definitions at p0086, p0092, p0069; assignee tax reference at p0415.

Ownership: 7.1.1 (p0427), 7.1.2 Joint IP (p0428–p0429), 7.1.3 (p0430), 7.1.4 assignment obligations (p0431–p0432). AbbVie owns Product Trademarks (p0485) and Regulatory Documentation in the Territory (p0327) — favourable, do not flag. p0537 is Harpoon's employee invention-assignment rep.

Grants to AbbVie in 5.1 (p0351–p0356), sublicensing 5.3 (p0359), retained rights 5.6.1 (p0363), option grant 3.2.3 (p0300). Confirm grants reach Affiliates and permitted subcontractors, are not revocable at will, and that the licence back to Harpoon (p0358) is narrow.

6.11 Audit (p0419) imposes record-keeping and audit access on AbbVie and its Affiliates/Sublicensees — assess frequency, notice, scope, cost allocation and confidentiality. 6.12 Audit Dispute/Audit Expert at p0420–p0421. p0332 is our inspection right over Harpoon (favourable; do not flag).

No liquidated damages, penalty or termination-fee language located. Only 6.10 Interest on Late Payments (p0418) — check the rate is market default interest rather than punitive; ordinary late-payment interest is not an LD deviation.

Mutual reps 10.1 (p0521); Harpoon-specific reps 10.2 (p0527, p0531, p0537, p0541, p0545); covenants at sec-10.3 and sec-10.4. 10.5 (p0557) disclaims implied warranties — confirm mutuality and that express warranties survive; note reps are Effective-Date only.

11.6 (p0573–p0579) requires each Party to carry minimum insurance (employer's liability p0576, general liability with additional-insured status p0577) and permits AbbVie self-insurance (p0579, favourable). Limits redacted [***]; confirm counterparty limits and whether product liability/clinical trial cover is included.

No minimum purchase, take-or-pay, volume or shortfall commitment found; the only 'minimum' hits are insurance limits in Article 11. Milestones and royalties in Article 6 are licence consideration, not volume commitments, and should not be re-flagged here.

Post-termination architecture: 12.6 Termination in Entirety (p0596–p0612) with Harpoon Reversion Products (p0600) and post-CSR option mechanics; 12.7 Reversion / AbbVie Reversion IP (p0623–p0624); 12.8 Terminated Territory (p0633); accrued rights and survival (p0636, p0639); inventory sell-off (p0640). Return/destruction of Confidential Information at p0517. Assess the burden of reversion obligations on us versus what we receive back.
